candidates.title: Anthropic Achieves $900 Billion Valuation, Overtaking OpenAI in Market Value
candidates.description: Anthropic reached a landmark $900 billion valuation, officially surpassing OpenAI in market value, driven by a five-fold increase in revenue since late 2024.

candidates.title: Vatican Establishes Interdicasterial Commission on Artificial Intelligence to Address Ethical Implications
candidates.description: Pope Leo XIV approved the creation of a new Interdicasterial Commission on Artificial Intelligence to coordinate the Holy See’s response to AI, focusing on human dignity and ethical implications. An encyclical is expected soon.

candidates.title: Israel Unveils National AI Directorate with 'AI Superpower' Strategy
candidates.description: The Israeli government approved a preliminary work plan for its National AI Directorate, aiming to secure 5,000 advanced GPUs annually for academia and public sector, attract global talent, and establish applied AI laboratories.

candidates.title: Anthropic Launches 'Claude for Small Business' with Integrated Workflows and Connectors
candidates.description: Anthropic introduced 'Claude for Small Business,' a suite offering ready-to-run AI workflows and connectors for popular tools like QuickBooks, PayPal, and Microsoft 365, aiming to provide enterprise-level AI to smaller firms.

candidates.title: OpenAI Partners with Malta to Provide ChatGPT Plus to All Citizens and Launch AI Literacy Program
candidates.description: OpenAI and the Government of Malta announced a world-first initiative to provide ChatGPT Plus to all Maltese citizens, including a mandatory AI literacy course developed by the University of Malta.
